bio: Research Overview Research Background Education Publications Contact Us Dr. Ross's research interests are in the field of pediatric resuscitation, specifically directed at peri-arrest management and prevention of pediatric in-hospital cardiac arrest. Her research has focused on preventing out-of-ICU cardiac arrest using pediatric early warning systems; aborting impending cardiac arrest in the intensive care unit with pre-arrest bolus epinephrine; and preventing cardiac arrest in pediatric massive pulmonary embolism.
